scope: we purified LDs from HeLa cells treated with oleic acid (OA)... We incubated the LD lysates with purified GST-LC3B, and then pulled down GST-LC3B for mass spectrometry analysis

LDs were purified from HeLa cells treated with 200 μM OA and 10 μM CQ overnight and lysed with 5% NP40 lysis buffer. The diluted lysates (containing 0.5% NP40) were then incubated with purified GST or GST-LC3B immobilized on GSH beads. Proteins associated with the beads were analyzed by tandem mass spectrometry.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis was performed on proteins affinity-purified using GST-LC3B beads from purified lipid droplet (LD) lysates. While LDs are organelles, the final material analyzed by MS was the affinity-captured complex.
